# Three-minute demo outline

This script distinguishes the working extension from the integrated app. Replace the first step with the main app upload/question flow only after that integration actually passes local checks.

1. 0:00–0:25 — Explain the purpose in one sentence: make lab information easier to understand and inspect its source. State that this is a local educational prototype.
2. 0:25–1:00 — Open the first screen and click ALT. Show differing institutional references and open an original source page. Explain that a range in the user's report takes priority and the preview does not choose a patient range.
3. 1:00–1:30 — Search เฟอร์ริติน. Open the WHO source/year/page and educational summary. Mention that this is a cited educational adaptation with a non-commercial license.
4. 1:30–1:55 — Search an unsupported test, show no invented answer, then reset. Show the same first action on a 390px viewport.
5. 1:55–2:25 — Show actual test/evaluation evidence, clearly labeling retrieval-only and mocked versus live. Mention that the small tree comparison is not a clinical quality study.
6. 2:25–2:55 — State business-data, live-provider and integration blockers. Describe HIS/pharmacy as planned interfaces only unless later verified. End with the demonstrated user benefit, not an unsupported production claim.

For the final coursework video, include the main OCR/chat and image/safety results only with actual recorded outputs from the integrated candidate. No video file was generated by this script.
